description: List the skills and commands saved in your Besidka account, most recently changed first, without their text: id, name, description, whether it is switched on, status (ready, needs-review or broken), license class, source, version, pending update, file count, size, who created it, whether the model may pick it by itself and its /command. Only your own skills. Use nextCursor to get the next page. Requires signing in (skills:read).

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page

kind.description: command lists skills that have a /command, skill lists the others; omit for both

name: list_skills
title: List my skills
